description: Validates sign-up form fields before an account is created. A username is 3 to 20 characters: a lower-case letter followed only by lower-case letters, digits and underscores, and not a reserved name. The email must look like an address and the password must be long enough and not contain the username. All problems are reported together.

key.statement: check_username uses an unanchored match, so any string that merely starts with a valid username (trailing markup, spaces, or over-long names) is accepted.
